## Summary

- Motivation and changes
- Related issue or proposal

## Stack and target

- [ ] Standalone change targeting `develop`
- [ ] Stack layer targeting its immediate predecessor
- [ ] Release promotion from `develop` into `main`
- Parent PR and ordered stack links

## Boundaries

- [ ] Core purity, sealed evaluation, receipts/replay and transform contracts preserved
- [ ] Accepted ADRs preserved or explicitly superseded
- [ ] Runtime changes satisfy the P0 compatibility decision

## Verification

- Exact commands and results
- Checks and environments untested

## Knowledge and documentation

- Knowledge IDs, `added_by` and `human_ratified` state, or none
- Docs, ADR and priors changes, or none

## Review and landing

- Authoring agent and model
- Independent reviewer and model, including cross-family or higher-effort fallback
- [ ] Rebased onto the target with linear history
- [ ] All review conversations resolved
- [ ] Integration change reviewed and ready for the reviewer to rebase-merge
- [ ] Release environment approved and PR merged by a human
